Check the IELTS 7.0 requirement or whether her MSc counts as English evidence

items.title: University of Reading International PhD Studentships (October 2027 entry)
items.org: University of Reading, Doctoral and Researcher College
items.summary: A university-wide competition only for applicants who pay international fees. It covers international tuition for up to four years, a stipend broadly at the UKRI rate (£21,805 in 2026/27) for Reading-based students and £1,000 a year for training; visa and IHS costs are not covered. Each School nominates one candidate, who then writes a short research proposal.
